literature_notes: Both ledger lines describe C-terminal tagging of ELFN2. L1 reports ELFN2-Venus (full-length) and ELFN2Δ418-Venus (truncated), with Venus inserted between the myc sequence and the stop codon; L2 confirms ELFN2-myc as a previously described C-terminal construct. The C-terminus of ELFN2 is residue 820 (L), which lies deep in the intracellular domain (residues 418–820). The ELFN2Δ418-Venus junction falls at residue 417/418, the TM–intracellular boundary, also not extracellular. No ledger line reports any tag insertion at the mature N-terminus (residue 23, extracellular) or anywhere in the extracellular domain (23–396). Because no qualifying insertion on the extracellular face is evidenced, sites = [].

literature_other_positions.note: ELFN2-Venus and ELFN2-myc are C-terminal fusions at residue 820, which is in the intracellular domain (418–820); tolerated but not on the extracellular surface.
ELFN2Δ418-Venus places Venus immediately after the last TM residue (417) at the TM–intracellular boundary; position 418 (C) is the first intracellular residue and not an extracellular surface site.
